problem_statement: The walltime subsystem must work when enabled through the walltime_default module. A caller that parses an ISO 8601 time with scn_time_tm_iso8601(), sets it with walltime_set(), reads it back with walltime_get(), and compares the result with rtc_tm_compare() must observe the time that was set, including dates such as 2020-01-01 12:34:56 and 2046-01-01 12:34:56. Setting a later wall time must not fail if the backend initially reports a time before the supported minimum time.
